messages:
Dominic R: uploaded the rift-lite7b quant sweep artifacts and a short econ summary. looking for a crisp recommendation we can hand to GTN + an ops checklist. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/rift-lite7b/1720001234/
Priya S: quick summary from the evaluation slices (conversational + retrieval + short-prompt): fp16 baseline cost = $1.00/unit (normed), throughput baseline = 1.0x. rift-lite7b-int8 -> cost = $0.46/unit (~2.2x cheaper), mean eval_pass_rate delta = -1.1% vs fp16 on our core prompt set. rift-lite7b-int6 -> cost = $0.34/unit (~2.9x cheaper), eval_pass_rate delta = -2.8%, and we observed a 5-8% hit on long-form factual recall.
Evan T: latency/throughput notes: p95 fp16 = 240ms, int8 = 170ms, int6 = 155ms. token-throughput increases: int8 ~1.9x, int6 ~2.6x. int6 also introduced rare coherence drift on 8+ turn chats in the retrieval slice.
Dominic R: good. product asked for one-line recommendation + two bullet operational caveats. what do people think?
Priya S: my suggestion: "Recommend rift-lite7b-int8 as the default for chat and assistant routes for most customers to capture ~2x unit cost savings and lower latency; reserve fp16 for long-horizon retrieval and manifest-critical lanes. Do not default to int6 except behind an opt-in or for non-customer-facing batch workloads."
Evan T: agree. add an embeddings note: for short outputs/embedding/rerank pipelines int6 had acceptable quality in our microbench and could be trialed separately.
Dominic R: propose a rollout strategy: small canary -> slice gates -> gradual ramp. specifics below.
Priya S: proposed gating rules (conservative):
- Canary start: 5% traffic (24h) on int8 for a single GTN route family.
- Metrics to monitor: per-slice eval_pass_rate (must be within -1.5% of fp16), recall@k for retrieval slice (no more than -2% drop), user-facing latency p95 (should improve).
- If any gate breaches: immediate auto-fallback to fp16 for the affected route and page on-call.
Evan T: ramp plan: 5% -> 25% (48h) -> 75% (48h) -> 100% with the same gating applied at each step. escalate on repeated daily eval delta >1.0% for the canary slice.
Dominic R: can we give SRE a sample routing snippet they can copy into the rollout product ticket?
Priya S: yes, quick pseudo-config:```
model_routing:
  default: rift-lite7b-int8
  canary:
    initial_pct: 5
    ramp: [25,75,100]
    monitors:
      - name: eval_pass_rate
        threshold: -0.015
      - name: retrieval_recall@20
        threshold: -0.02
      - name: latency_p95_ms
        compare: improve
  fallbacks:
    - when: retrieval_recall@20 <= -0.02
      to: rift-lite7b-fp16
    - when: eval_pass_rate <= -0.015
      to: rift-lite7b-fp16
```
Evan T: operational caveats for the GTN note: 1) daily automated slice reports for the first 7 days, 2) enable per-route sampling to keep a shadow fp16 copy for randomized QA checks, 3) tag the canary request traces with model_variant for traceability.
Dominic R: I'll draft a one-paragraph note for GTN and include the artifacts + the pseudo-config and the 3 action items.
infra-bot: artifact registered: s3://redwood-artifacts/rift-lite7b/1720001234/sweep-report.csv at 1720001300
Priya S: additional thought: we should add a short post-canary checklist for ML: re-run the offline eval slice with the live traffic distribution after 48h at 25% to catch distributional drift.
Evan T: and SRE: add an alert if daily eval_pass_rate delta exceeds -1.0% for two consecutive days.
Dominic R: action items (owners): 1) Dominic -> draft GTN note + attach artifacts (today), 2) SRE (@Evan T) -> implement canary routing + alerts (tomorrow), 3) ML (@Priya S) -> schedule the 48h post-canary offline eval and daily slice reports.
Priya S: tagging relevant leads: @Evan T @Dominic R :white_check_mark:
